coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 9 ground-truth variable items (33%): target properties (p-logP, QED, and affinity), model configurations broadly covering pretrained/no-feedback, feedback-finetuned, and baseline models, and structural diversity including long carbon chains.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the specified pipeline scripts, constant DeepSpeed framework, ESR1/ACAA1 targets, and synthetic versus natural-product domains. Reports aggregate property statistics rather than top-three scores and omits the target-specific affinity improvements of approximately 96.7% and 70.4%. Substitutes a generic CPU-based generator and affinity surrogate for the specified MOLGEN experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing all expected findings: exceptionally high p-logP scores up to 80.30, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with ESR1/ACAA1 improvements, reduced molecular hallucinations, and maintained diversity.
